target_customer: Consumers researching purchases and topics who want social media perspectives (Reddit, blogs, YouTube) in one results page
problem: Search results and AI summaries miss the opinions of real users on Reddit, YouTube and blogs; Lumona aggregates them.
business_model: Free consumer product at last check; no revenue model found

founders.name: Qiong Zhou Huang
prior_employers: Startups in computer vision, remote work and edtech (unnamed)
education: MIT, computer science, ML research at the McGovern Institute

founders.name: Philena Liu
education: MIT, CS with a math minor
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. YC launch post names only Dylan and Qiong.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and summarizing existing social content with LLMs and search APIs in 2024 was mostly integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Reddit, Google and Perplexity could add the same social perspective feature, and the data sources belong to third parties.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large AI search products added Reddit and social sources broadly; no source on Lumona specifically.

market_need_then: Users in 2023 and 2024 added the word reddit to Google queries to get real opinions, and AI search was a hot category, but no demand figures for Lumona were found.

branding.domain_note: Used lumona.ai; the site returned HTTP 404 during the check.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual founder voice, asked for feedback via a Discord server

branding.community_and_virality: Founders ran a Discord server for feedback per the YC launch post; no wider evidence

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; the name is easily confused with Lumo and Lumora products.

outcome_analysis: Lumona entered YC in Winter 2024 with an AI search engine built on social media perspectives and a three person MIT team, reportedly raising only the standard pre seed money. The site now returns 404 and YC lists it inactive, but no post mortem or news explains why, so the cause is not public.
notes: Competitor list left empty: the launch post names only Google and generic AI answers without a dated rival source, and my search for 2023 to 2024 rivals returned only 2026 listicles. Funding rests on VCBacked and Choppingblock (single database basis); CB Insights says latest round is Seed VC without detail. YC lists team size 1 though three founders appear.
